name: Example 1: Syntax Error - Missing Parenthesis
description:
Problem

Complete the function to greet a user by name.

Requirements

  • Function should take a name parameter
  • Use console.log to print "Hello, [name]!"
learning_objective: Understanding parenthesis matching and syntax errors

name: Example 2: Runtime Error - Undefined Variable
description:
Problem

Fix the function that calculates the area of a rectangle.

Requirements

  • Function should take width and height parameters
  • Return the calculated area
  • Use console.log to print the result
learning_objective: Identifying typos and undefined variable errors

name: Example 3: Logic Error - Off-by-One
description:
Problem

Write a function that sums all elements in an array.

Requirements

  • Function should take an array parameter
  • Return the sum of all elements
  • Handle empty arrays (return 0)
expected_error: TypeError: Cannot read property of undefined (accessing arr[arr.length])
learning_objective: Understanding array indexing and off-by-one errors
